scope:
Build the native phase codec with the non-Apple LLVM toolchain, check it against the bit-exact vectors,
then cross-check it against the Python reference on the pinned corpus: native encode must equal Python encode
byte for byte and native decode must reproduce every sample. Writes results/native_phase.json. Intended to run
on the M4 through m4build; the Python reference encodes are the slow part (about 50 us per pixel) and run in a
process pool. Usage: python -B -m research.run_native_phase [--workers N] [--limit N] [--skip-corpus]
